WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        ProductKey,
        max(DateKey) AS max_date
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    GROUP BY
        StoreKey,
        ProductKey
)
SELECT
    i.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName,
    sum(i.OnHandQuantity) AS current_on_hand_quantity,
    sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS current_safety_stock_quantity,
    sum(i.OnHandQuantity) - sum(i.SafetyStockQuantity) AS inventory_gap
FROM retail.FactInventory AS i
INNER JOIN latest AS l
    ON i.StoreKey = l.StoreKey
   AND i.ProductKey = l.ProductKey
   AND i.DateKey = l.max_date
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p
    ON i.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
GROUP BY
    i.ProductKey,
    p.ProductName
ORDER BY abs(inventory_gap) DESC
LIMIT 10
